children: A new Terra governance proposal dated 25 Oct 2026 outlines a recovery process after the Ill Bloom compromise of legacy Terra Station Desktop. The proposal includes potential reimbursement for verified claims using funds from the PF Treasury.
The PF Treasury would provide the financial mechanism for addressing the incident, giving the proposed recovery process a defined source of funds for reimbursements.
A new Terra Governance proposal outlines the recovery process following the legacy Terra Station Desktop Ill Bloom compromise.
The proposal includes potential reimbursement of verified claims from the PF Treasury.

title: Terra: Governance proposal outlines recovery after Station Desktop compromise - 25 Oct 2026
